item.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship 2027
item.description:
An eight-month fellowship for artists, educators and engineers building open-source tools and resources for the arts, in three tracks: Gaming the System (an open-source game-design toolkit co-designed with underserved young people in Los Angeles, backed by the Riot Games Social Impact Fund), Collective Intelligence (youth AI education with the Mark Cuban Foundation) and DIY Computing (cyberdecks in New York). Every project must build on p5.js, the p5.js Editor or Processing.
Deadline: 2026-11-01. Nominations close 11:59 PM PST; invited nominees submit proposals by November 23 Plus open-source mentorship, a cohort, professional development and public programs. Fee not stated
Eligibility: US-based nominees only; self-nomination is welcome. Gaming the System is hybrid in Los Angeles, for game makers, creative coders and educators based there; DIY Computing is hybrid in New York; Collective Intelligence is remote anywhere in the US.
Video interviews the week of December 7; fellows notified the week of December 14; final presentations October 2, 2027.
Official call: https://processingfoundation.org/programs/fellowships/fellowship-2027/ Checked 2026-10-29
